listing:
Affordable Furnished Sublet on Hazel St — 317 Hazel St, Waterloo, ON

Available Jan 1 – Apr 30, 2027 for $880/month (heat, water, hydro, and Wi-Fi included). Bright furnished bedroom in a 4BR apartment, 10-minute walk to UW Engineering buildings. The owner lives in Hamilton (not on site) and keeps things super low-maintenance. You can come see the unit in person any weekday evening—just email hazel317@example.com. Because the rent is kept low, the sublet is offered strictly as-is: the written agreement states that the tenant takes care of and pays for any minor plumbing leaks, appliance breakdowns, or heating fixes during the 4 months so the owner doesn't have to deal with repairs.
label_rationale: Genuine listing with ONE subtle paraphrased maintenance waiver: renting 'strictly as-is' and shifting plumbing, appliance, and heating repairs onto the tenant conflicts with the landlord's statutory repair duty under Ontario RTA s. 20(1)-(2) and is void under s. 4(1). Not a scam; under SPEC D6, HOLD.
